name: Parking Lot At Walmart
summary: This Walmart location in Salinas, California serves as a vital retail hub for the local agricultural community, offering affordable everyday essentials with convenient early morning hours starting at 6:00 AM. The facility provides practical, value-oriented shopping for diverse, budget-conscious families in Monterey County's Central Valley region.
demographics: The Walmart parking lot in Salinas serves a diverse, value-conscious customer base typical of California's Central Valley agricultural region. Primary visitors include working-class families, agricultural workers, and budget-minded shoppers with household incomes ranging from lower to middle class. The trade area draws heavily from Salinas's predominantly Hispanic population (approximately 75% of the city), along with multi-generational households seeking everyday essentials and discounted merchandise. Shopping patterns reflect a focus on one-stop convenience, bulk purchasing, and price-sensitive decision-making common to Walmart's core demographic.
description: The Parking Lot at Walmart in Salinas, California represents a quintessential big-box retail destination serving the heart of Monterey County's agricultural community. Located in Salinas, known as the "Salad Bowl of the World," this Walmart location provides essential shopping services to a diverse population of residents and agricultural workers who depend on affordable, convenient access to groceries, household goods, and general merchandise. The facility operates with extended hours, opening at 6:00 AM to accommodate early-morning shoppers and those with non-traditional work schedules common in the agricultural industry. With a rating of 3.5 stars from 11 reviews, the location serves as a practical shopping destination for value-conscious consumers seeking Walmart's signature combination of low prices and wide product selection. The parking lot itself provides ample space for the high volume of customers who rely on this location for their everyday shopping needs, reflecting Walmart's commitment to accessibility and convenience in communities across America.
